message.content: The catheter was an indwelling tube placed in my continent MAINZ pouch to drain urine continuously. It was put in because I have a urinary diversion after my bladder surgery. The severe lower‑abdominal pain and shortness of breath began after the catheter stopped working the night before I came in and have gotten worse since then. I don’t have any fever or chills, and I’m not sure about any trouble passing urine or gas.
